title: Debian (APT) repository settings
description: The deb member of a repository document. A member lists the classes it applies to in x-trove-classes; a member of another class is refused as not applicable.

architectures.title: Architectures
architectures.description: The architectures apt clients can install from, such as amd64 and arm64; in a local repository an upload of another architecture adds it. Architecture-independent packages appear under each one, so the architecture all is not listed here.

compression.title: Compression
compression.description: Package indexes are always offered gzip-compressed; choose xz to offer smaller xz-compressed ones as well.

origin.title: Origin
origin.description: The origin apt reports for this repository, which pinning rules can match. Up to 64 characters, no colon.

label.title: Label
label.description: The label apt reports for this repository, which pinning rules can match. Left empty, it is the repository's key.

suites.title: Suites
suites.description: Further suites to serve from the remote members, such as bookworm-backports. The suites of the local members are always served.

components.title: Components
components.description: The components to serve, such as main and contrib, merged from all members.

upstreamKeys.title: Upstream keys
upstreamKeys.description: The upstream's public signing keys, pasted as one armored OpenPGP block of up to 32 keys. With them trove checks every release before storing it; a mirror and a member of a virtual repository need them.

mirror.title: Mirror
mirror.description: What a mirror of the APT archive keeps.

suites.title: Suites
suites.description: The suites to mirror, such as bookworm and bookworm-updates. A mirror needs at least one.

components.title: Components
components.description: The components to keep, such as main, contrib or non-free-firmware.

architectures.title: Architectures
architectures.description: The architectures whose packages are kept, such as amd64. Architecture-independent packages are always kept, so the architecture all is not listed here.

translations.title: Translations
translations.description: The languages of the package descriptions to keep, such as en or de.
